description_en: Sets whether to enable the certificate feature for a domain name and updates the certificate information
description_zh: 调用SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate设置某域名下是否启用证书功能及更新证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn set-dcdn-domain-ssl-certificate --domain-name example.com --ssl-protocol off --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate

parameters.help_en: The domain name to which the certificate belongs. The domain name must be of the HTTPS acceleration type
parameters.help_zh: 证书所属的服务域名，需属于HTTPS加速类型
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The certificate name. Only a single certificate name is supported. This parameter takes effect only when CertType is set to upload. This parameter is optional when CertType is set to upload and specifies the name of the new certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书名称，目前只支持单个证书名称，只有CertType=upload时生效。
CertType=upload时选填，给新证书的名称
parameters.name: cert_name

parameters.help_en: The certificate ID. This parameter takes effect only when CertType is set to cas. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas and specifies an existing certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID，只有CertType=cas时生效。
CertType=cas时必填，表示选择已有证书
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

upload: uploaded certificate.
cas: certificate from SSL Certificates Service
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

upload：上传证书。
cas：证书中心证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the HTTPS certificate. Valid values:

on: enables the HTTPS certificate.
off: disables the HTTPS certificate
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

on：启用。
off：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol

parameters.help_en: The content of the security certificate. This parameter is not required if the certificate is disabled. If you configure a certificate, enter the certificate content
parameters.help_zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en: The content of the private key. This parameter is not required if the certificate is disabled. If you configure a certificate, enter the private key content
parameters.help_zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容
parameters.name: ssl_pri

parameters.help_en: The region where the certificate is located. Valid values: cn-hangzhou and ap-southeast-1. Default value: cn-hangzhou. International site users should use ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh: 证书所在地域。支持cn-hangzhou和ap-southeast-1，默认cn-hangzhou。国际站用户建议使用ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: cert_region
